@id.description: Unique IRI identifying the documented resource.

@type.description: IRI of the class the resource belongs to.

title.description: A name given to the resource.

description.description: A free-text account of the resource.

comment.description: A description of the subject resource. Use `description` instead.

keyword.description: A keyword or tag describing the resource.

seeAlso.description: Indicates a resource that might provide additional information about the subject resource.

license.description: A licence under which the resource is made available.

landingPage.description: A web page that provides access to the resource and/or additional information (e.g. the distribution for a dataset).

version.description: Version indicator (name or identifier) of a resource.
